headline: Approved changes to a governance framework, plus utility poles on Uxbridge Road and Manchaug Road and a Zoning Board of Appeals appointment.
summary: Members accepted FY27 goals for the board and Town Manager. The Town Manager reported on the Depot Street Bridge project, about $113,000 in extra state aid, and the fall paving list. Members also discussed food pantry needs and community garden ideas.
decisions: Approved the July 7, 2026 meeting minutes, 3-0 with 1 abstention.
Approved the July 21, 2026 work session minutes with a date correction, 3-0 with 1 abstention.
Approved Pole Hearing #31239135 for a new stub pole on Manchaug Road, 4-0.
Approved Pole Hearing #31283809 to move a pole on Uxbridge Road, 4-0.
Appointed Troy Zachery Foley to the Zoning Board of Appeals to fill a 3-year term expiring 6/30/2027, 4-0.
Signed the September 1, 2026 State Primary Warrant, 4-0.
Approved the changes to the Governance Framework except items 2, 3, 4, 12, 18, 21 and 23, 4-0.
Rejected the proposed change to item 2 and kept the original language, 4-0.
Kept the original language of item 3 in the Governance Framework, 4-0.
Kept the original language of item 4 in the Governance Framework, 4-0.
Accepted item 12 on professional appearance with no change, 4-0.
Changed the word personal to individual in item 18, 4-0.
Kept the wording of item 21 as in version 1.5, 4-0.
Changed Board of Directors to Chief Executive Officers in item 23, 4-0.
Accepted the FY27 Select Board and Town Manager goals, 3-0 with 1 abstention.

                                                                                                    Meeting Minutes
                                                 Minutes Accepted and file with the Town Clerk 8/18/2026   with a roll call vote of  3-0 with 1 abstention 
                                                               Ettamarna absent-Spengler absent from 8/4/26 meeting
                                                                                             6:00 p.m. –  August 4, 2026                  
   HYBRID MEETING Roll Call vote taken:
Members in Attendance:
Chairperson Anderson, Vice Chair Ettamarna, Select members Limanek & Watkins all present in person (Spengler absent)
Also attending in person: Town Manager Austin Cyganiewicz & Deb Jacques, secretary
Public Forum – N/A
Select person Limanek motions to accept as presented the July 7, 2026 Select Board meeting minutes as presented, Vice Chair 
Ettamarna seconds passes 3-0 and 1 abstention (Ettamarna abstains-absent from 7/7/26 meeting) -  Limanek “aye”, Watkins “aye” 
Anderson “aye”
Vice Chair Ettamarna motions to approve the Select Board Work Session minutes from 7/21/2026 but amend date to read July 21, 
2026 not the 22nd Select person Watkins seconds passes 3-0 with 1 abstention- Limanek abstains absent from 7/21 meeting, Ettamarna
“aye”, Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye” 
*Public Pole Hearing* Manchaug Road- hearing read into record by Select member Watkins- present from NGrid on Zoom is Charlie.
Charlie states the reason for this is to install a new stub pole to act as a span guy to replace an old tree being used for this purpose. 
Hearing no questions/comments Vice Chair Ettamarna motions to close the Public Hearing, Select Watkins seconds passes 4-0 with 
roll call vote. Vice Chair Ettamarna motions to approve Pole Hearing #31239135 from NGrid and Verizon for Manchaug Road as 
advertised in the July 9, 2026 Millbury Sutton Chronicle Select Watkins seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote: Limanek “aye” 
Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye” 
*Public Pole Hearing* Uxbridge Road- hearing read into record by Select Watkins- zooming in with NGrid is Erica Troha- Erica 
states the pole is being moved 4ft as the pole continues to get clipped at the intersection. Select member Limanek thanks NGrid for 
coming back to the table as this was before the Select Board a short while ago. Jesse hopes this makes the radius of turning safer. 
Hearing no other comments from the board John Belculfine of 75 Leland Hill Road still feels the pole will be too close to the road and
not much of an improvement.  Erica (NGrid) replies it is not directly on the road way and this is the only way it would work. Mr. 
Belculfine also questions who coordinates the movement of the lines- Erica states once the pole is in, they notify Verizon and they 
have 90 days to coordinate moving their line; when all lines are moved the old pole will be removed. Police Chief Calouro(present) 
states he has visited both sites as well as another hearing coming next month- this will be an absolute improvement. Select Watkins 
motions to close the public hearing Vice Chair Ettamarna seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote. Select Watkins motions to approve 
Pole Hearing #31283809 from NGrid and Verizon for Uxbridge Road as advertised in the July 16, 2026 Millbury Sutton Chronicle, 
Select Limanek seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote. Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”
ZBA 3-year appointment – present is Zack Foley of 360 Boston Road- Zach introduces himself- he attended ZBA meetings previously
with the LeClaire family members and he found the ZBA to be well run, informative and was impressed with their site visits. He 
wanted to step up and volunteer. The Select board thank Zack for volunteering and like his enthusiasm. Select Limanek motions to 
appoint Troy Zachery Foley to the Zoning Board of Appeals to fill the remaining 3-year term left vacant by Patrick O’Hara with an 
expiration of 6/30/2027 at which time Zack (Troy) can request reappointment, Select Watkins seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote:  
Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”
www.suttonma.gov
Sign September 1, 2026 State Primary Warrant:  Town Manager Cyganiewicz states this is for the State Primary Election which will 
run 7am-8pm. The deadline to register to vote is August 22, deadline to vote by mail is August 25th and early voting will be held from 
August 22-28th.  Vice Chair Ettamarna motions to sign the September 1, 2026 State Primary Warrant Select Limanek seconds passes 
4-0 with roll call vote: Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”
Select Board Governance Framework document- Chairperson Anderson informs the public this is something the Select board has been
working on- there were a couple working sessions in the spring where this draft document was written with 29 proposed changes to 
that document. Today we will do a consent approval of the document as a whole- some of the items will be pulled out and discussed in
more detail.  This is to act as a guide book for how the Select Board operates- it includes norms (behavior) and policies (laws- MGL, 
Town Charter or Bylaws). Seven items will be pulled and discussed in more depth. Select Watkins motions to approve the changes to 
the Framework except for items 2, 3, 4, 12, 18, 21 & 23; Vice Chair Ettamarna seconds passes 4-0 roll call vote Limanek “aye” 
Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”. Vice Chair Ettamarna voices the importance of not creating policies that are covered 
by the Town Charter or MGL. Jim reads from the Town Charter under 3.2 regarding the Select board and their powers, duties and 
authority. This is so we do not duplicate documents.  Select Limanek does not feel we are duplicating- we are basing our policies on 
the Charter and he considers that a sound practice.
The 1st item (#2) Executive not Representative: the last sentence- Jim questions striking “public communications on the matter” Jim 
does not want to control speech and questions replacing the word public with official. After discussion Jim is ok leaving as is. Select 
Watkins motions to reject the proposed change in item # 2 and keep the original language, Select Limanek seconds passes 4-0 with 
roll call vote: Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”.
Item #3- Respect for Statutory Authority- questions what does day to day mean with the Select Board authority. After discussion 
Select Watkins motions to keep original language in Section 3, Select Limanek seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote; Limanek “aye” 
Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”.
Item #4 Respect for Town Mgr. & staff interaction- Jim states the main thing is to have the strategic piece known to the staff. After 
brief discussion Select Watkins motions to keep the original language in item# 4 Select Limanek seconds passes 4-0 with roll call 
vote: Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”.
Item #12 Professional appearance- do we want to continue with the ties or can dress be business casual? This is a farm town. After 
discussion the board agrees to keep it in place. Select Watkins motions to accept and make no change to the language, Select Limanek 
seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote:  Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”.
Item #18- Speaking with one voice after the vote- Vice Chair Ettamarna feels the word personal in the last sentence should be changed
to individual. After discussion Select Watkins motions to accept the change as discussed in item 18 Select Limanek seconds passes 4-
0 with roll call vote:  Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”.
Items #21 Participation on Other Boards- Jim questions if we could have a discussion at our meetings and coordinate a message or 
questions to the staff. Select Limanek states that is kind of what we do- we speak to the Town Manager and in turn the Town Manager
speaks to the Dept. Heads. We cannot go to another Board meeting and speak with any type of authority- we can react to the different 
boards when they come before us.  Chair Anderson says there is a fine line we can walk with our 1st amendment rights to be able to 
speak at any board meeting and you are there speaking as an individual and not on behalf of the Select board. Select Watkins motions 
to keep the wording as is in version 1.5 for #21 Select Limanek second passes 4-0, Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” 
Anderson “aye”.
Item #23 Continuous Improvement & Strategic Planning- Vice Chair Ettamarna questions the title “Board of Directors” he finds it 
confusing. He would prefer to see Chief Executive Officers. The board agrees with this. Select Watkins motions to accept the word 
change as discussed (Board of Directors to Chief Executive Officers) for #23 Select Limanek seconds passes 4-0 with roll call vote.  
Limanek “aye” Ettamarna “aye Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”.
Accept FY27 Select Board & Town Manager goals: Chair Anderson states the following is from the offsite goals held 2 weeks ago. 
The Facilitator was Jeff Nutting. Under the Select Board goals, the following items are mentioned- Finalizing governance framework- 
complete by September, Establish committee to review Town Charter & general bylaws-target time longer term; Board Operations & 
Oversight-Develop a Town Mgr. evaluation policy –Jim E and Dan S will have a working group with HR to form and deliver by 
October, Hold a public safety work session to include Police, Fire, Highway and Building. This will begin in January; Land Use & 
Community Development- review the use of town owned land- we will start with Marion’s Camp and Shaw Farm. What is our 
strategic vision for town owned properties? Hold a joint meeting with Planning, ZBA and Select Board on Community Development 
strategy- this is to ensure all boards are shooting for the same goal. Also- review the Master Plan, update where needed. Hold a joint 
meeting with Wilks Water and Manchaug Water prior to the Spring Town meeting- Select Watkins recommends separate meetings as 
they represent different parts of town. 
Town Manager goals, Advance the Town Common project & design- time frame is ongoing. Complete the Fire Dept. study & present 
findings- this is due to board at a Sept meeting. Infrastructure & Public Works- Develop an administrative re-organization plan to 
create DPW (reorg plan for Sewer/cemetery) bring to Spring Town meeting. Continue work on Municipal & school sewer feasibility
www.suttonma.gov
study- time frame is ongoing. Personnel & Admin – request funding at the Fall TM for employee pay & classification Study-Fall town
meeting. Coordinate brief annual presentation by Dept. Heads to the board- time frame-ongoing. After brief discussion Select Watkins
motions to accept the FY27 Select Board and Town Manager Goals Vice Chair Ettamarna seconds passes 3-0 with 1 abstention- 
Limanek abstains absent from 7/21 meeting, Ettamarna “aye”, Watkins “aye” Anderson “aye”
Town Manager Update:
 Depot Street Bridge- The I-beams were installed last week. Thank you to the residents for their patience with this MassDOT 
project. Anticipated completion is year end.
 Sutton Leadership Group – this group will hold its first meeting on August 12th at 9am. We intend to begin discussions on the
topic of revenue, both historical and projected.
 FY2027 State Budget- The Gov. signed the FY27 budget with no changes to the conference comm. recommendations. This 
results in approx.. $113,000 increase in state aid then what was projected. We also received an earmark for $30,000 to deal 
with the PFAS expenses at the landfill location. There is also $40,000. In the Town Mgr. budget for the additional expenses. 
 Charging Stations at Town Hall- We have received approx. $7500. From NGrid to upgrade the EV charging station at town 
hall. This will allow us to require payment for use of the stations. This will consolidate our EV stations to one platform 
(Charge point) like the one in the school parking lot.
 Fall Road paving- The Highway Dept. has finalized the fall paving list through Chap 90. The roads to be paved: Johnson, 
Cole, Tuttle, Merriam, Maple, Mumford, Southwick, Torrey, Manchaug, Stone School, Leland Hill Burdon and Colonial. 
 Simonian Center Elem School solar array- The replacement of 5000 blocks is almost complete- remaining work will include 
electrical components to insure solar is functioning properly. 
 Sutton center Cemetery GPR project- an update is included from Linda & Ross Weaver of the Historical Society on the 
ground penetrating radar. 
 HR Director Professional Development- Congratulations to Erin Chinappi HR Director for being accepted into MMA-
Suffolk University beginning in Sept. This is a 10-week class that covers HR management, policies and practices specific to 
public service. 
 Community locations for Austin- Austin would like to get out and meet more residents- please let him know of events he can 
attend. Select Watkins mentions the potluck at 8 lots school house on 8/7 at 6:30 at this event they will be awarding the 2 
scholarships; Vice Chair Ettamarna says homecoming, sports games, Waters Farm Days. Select Limanek mentions the 9/11 
ceremony at the Dudley Gendron followed by the annual chicken barbecue to he held on 9/12. 
Select Board Round Table
Select Limanek again mentions the 9/11 event and the chicken barbecue at the Dudley Gendron on Sept 12th and reads the 
lengthy list of needed items for the Food Pantry (many items are noted they are completely out of) 
Vice Chair Ettamarna has been approached asking about Community gardens- Jim has seen a garden while attending a 
sporting event in Uxbridge in listening to the list of needs for the Food Pantry there are residents in town with food 
insecurities- this could be a fun event but grow produce for the families in need. Jim thanks the July 4th committee for the 
recent parade. Millbury has started using rodenticides- does Sutton use this? It is harmful to animals.   
Select Watkins invites all to the 8 lots school house potluck to be held this Friday at 6:30pm.
                                       List of documents used for meeting
2 Pole Hearing requests, State Primary Warrant for signatures, Governance Framework document, Select Board & Town Manager 
goals, Update of GPR project by Ross & Linda Weaver, food pantry list
Select person Limanek motions to adjourn, Vice Chair Ettamarna 2nds passes 4-0 – Limanek “aye” Watkins “aye” Ettamarna “aye” 
Anderson “aye”
Meeting adjourned   8:50pm
